PAN-OS 12.1.5 Addressed Issues

The following table lists the issues addressed in PAN-OS 12.1.5.

Management Plane Addressed Issues

Issue ID Description
PAN-299001 Fixed an issue where commit operations would hang when objects had circular references.
PAN-299002 Resolved memory leak in the management daemon during extended operation.
PAN-299003 Fixed SNMP walk returning incomplete interface data.
PAN-299004 Corrected API response formatting for certain XML queries.

Data Plane Addressed Issues

Issue ID Description
PAN-299005 Fixed packet loss issue during SSL decryption with certain cipher suites.
PAN-299006 Resolved NAT session creation failures under high connection rates.

Security Addressed Issues

Issue ID Description
PAN-299007 Fixed vulnerability in authentication handling (CVE-2024-XXXX).
PAN-299008 Resolved cross-site scripting vulnerability in web interface.
